name: Richard W Sears
reason: Health restore re-check, 13 Nov 2026 (psych-insights.com home, about, mindfulness, audio, online-training and contact pages; robots.txt allows us; site found via his Greater Good profile in search): his own site is still a clinical psychology practice ('Clinical Psychologist and Mindfulness Teacher', telepsychology video clients in 42-43 states). His mindfulness teaching is Mindfulness-Based Cognitive Therapy / MBSR, which the brief counts as psychotherapy, and the in-person page sells the groups partly on preventing 'relapses of depression' (a condition claim); in-person groups have none scheduled. Most of his dozen-plus books are clinical (ACT, MBCT for PTSD, CBT toolbox, consultation skills). He has Zen and Tendai ordinations and a Buddhist-studies doctorate (about page), but the site offers no Zen teaching, sangha, retreat or dharma programme of his own; only one free-recordings page (body scan, breath, loving-kindness) sits outside the clinical frame. Skipped as mainly therapy (scope rule). Email richard@psych-insights.com; base Cincinnati, Ohio (contact page).
